newsitem.title: USA: Parallel Petroleum has Yegua natgas output.
newsitem.headline: Parallel Petroleum has Yegua natgas output.

text.p: Parallel Petroleum Corp said Tuesday a natural gas well in Wharton County, onshore the Texas Gulf Coast is producing at a stabilized rate of about 3 million cubic feet of natural gas and 35 barrels of condensate per day.

The Cox & Perkins Priesmeyer No. 1 well, completed in the Yegua formation, had a calculated open flow potential of 96.9 million cubic feet per day, the company said. On an 8/64-inch choke, the well flowed at a rate of 2.2 million cubic feet of natural gas and 25 barrels of condensate per day. The tests were made from selective perforations from 8,360 to 8,396 feet.

Parallel owns a 20 percent working interest (15.9 percent net revenue interest) in the well. Privately held Cox & Perkins Exploration Inc is operator of the project and owns a 10 percent working interest. Other working interest owners are Seitel Inc, 50 percent; El Paso Energy Corp, 10 percent, and individuals who own the remaining 10 percent.
